_comment: Edition-specific facts the pipeline needs but must not hardcode. Read by ingest.py, which passes them into chunk_blocks(). A new system adds a sibling directory with its own copy; a new *edition* of the same book needs page_offset and footer_format re-verified before ingesting, per docs/rules-extraction-findings.md.
_drop_pages_comment: PHYSICAL, 0-based page indices -- not printed page numbers. 4, 41, 42 are the character-creation spread (41 and 42 are byte-identical duplicates of 4), excluded because the Warden structurally cannot reach them: rules_lookup is wired only into the play-loop tool array and character creation makes no Anthropic calls at all. 3 is the character-profile sheet, excluded on measured evidence rather than reachability: it held 10 of 147 top-3 slots and outranked the correct page for two answerable combat queries. 0 and 2 are the cover and the credits/content-warning page -- no rules content. 11 and 12 (FIREARMS, INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT) restate the inside-cover reference card in a different format; their Table blocks all extract empty, and dropping them keeps --include-section-headers from resurrecting the pages as bare topic labels with no table body. See docs/decisions.md 'Character-creation content is excluded from the rules index', 'The reference-card duplicates stay in the rules index', 'Footer-less pages inherit the preceding chapter', and docs/rules-extraction-findings.md S2, S3.2, S17, S18, S19.
_chapterless_pages_comment: PHYSICAL, 0-based. Pages that belong to no chapter in the printed book, as distinct from pages whose running footer failed to parse. 1 and 43 are the inside-cover and back-cover reference cards -- they sit outside the chapter structure, so inheriting the preceding page's chapter would invent an attribution the page does not make. Every other footer-less page inherits; see pipeline/extract.py fill_chapter_gaps.
